payload.answer: [hard] The ledger is append-only: abandoning is a recorded phase transition emitting an event, never a delete or an update-in-place of history. [hard] Go through the same application service the CLI and the operator both call -- a single choke point. [hard] Decide and implement what happens to the project's in-flight work: jobs in ready/leased/awaiting_human must not be left claimable, or a worker will keep picking up work for an abandoned project. Cancelling them is the natural answer, and CANCELLED is currently a dead enum value never written by anything -- but note the job-lifecycle-commands project is separately defining stop/restart semantics over that same state, so coordinate rather than inventing a conflicting meaning. [hard] Idempotent: abandoning an already-abandoned project succeeds quietly rather than erroring. [hard] Refuse to abandon a DONE project silently -- require confirmation or a flag, since DONE carries evidence. [hard] 100% branch coverage, domain purity, Conventional Commits, feature branch into develop.
